messages:
Sam K.: Heads-up — offer accepted by Taylor Nguyen, start date Monday 2025-03-17. Can people-ops confirm I-9 / background check intake status and Day-1 orientation schedule?
Amy Diaz: Congrats! Adding checklist below and starting intake today. Will need:
```
- I-9 docs: passport OR driver license + SS card
- Completed I-9 form via Workday link
- Background check consent (link sent by Checkr)
- W-4 + direct deposit form
```
Amy Diaz: I just triggered the Checkr invite (should arrive within 10m). people-ops-bot will post status updates. :white_check_mark:
people-ops-bot: Checkr invite sent to taylor.nguyen@example.com at 2025-03-12T14:05:12Z. Status: invited.
Sam K.: Thanks Amy — did we route the I-9 to be completed on Day 1 in-office? Candidate is remote but will be in SF office Mon morning.
Amy Diaz: Yes — choose "inspect in person" option. Luis, can you meet Taylor at 9:30am to verify documents? I'll bring printed I-9 form as backup.
Luis Pereira: Yep I can meet at 9:30am by reception. Also planning a 30m team intro + 1:1 at 2pm.
Jordan Lee: IT note: I'm provisioning a MacBook + access. Will have laptop imaged and Zoom installed before EOD Friday. Slack invite already pending. Any special apps?
Amy Diaz: Add: Google Workspace, Okta, Jira, GitHub (org invite) — Jordan, please add Redwood onboarding role which auto-assigns repo access.
Jordan Lee: Got it. I'll create a temporary password reset link and tag @Sam when ready.
Sam K.: Payroll / benefits: Amy, when can Taylor expect benefits enrollment window?
Amy Diaz: Benefits email + enrollment link goes out on Day 1 after payroll profile completes (usually within 24h). I'll add Taylor to the new hire benefits group now so they see plan docs.
people-ops-bot: Payroll profile for Taylor Nguyen created at 2025-03-12T15:12:00Z.
Amy Diaz: Day-1 agenda (short):
- 9:30am: in-person I-9 (Luis + people-ops)
- 10:15am: team intro (30m)
- 11:00am: IT setup + account walkthrough
- 1:00pm: HR benefits overview (30m)
- 2:00pm: hiring manager 1:1
Amy Diaz: Quick reminders for Sam: please confirm candidate brings original docs (no photocopies) and fills the I-9 Section 1 before meeting. Send the Checkr confirmation to Taylor and cc me.
Sam K.: Will do. One more Q: background check turn-around on level 1 (standard) — estimate?
people-ops-bot: Typical turnaround: 24-72 hours for standard checks. If any arrest records or SSN trace issues flagged, flagged items will be routed to people-ops.
Amy Diaz: Filing note for the record: once Checkr returns clear, I'll mark eligibility in Workday and trigger benefits enrollment. If anything flags, I'll loop in Legal and the recruiter.
Luis Pereira: Sounds good. Thanks all — see you Mon. :wave:
Sam K.: Thanks team! I’ll send Taylor a final Day-1 logistics email now with meet-up location and docs list.
Amy Diaz: Thanks — adding a post-hire checklist item for follow-up at EOD Day 1 to confirm everything completed.
